function mountGenieGpu(
   canvas, 
   el,

   opening, 
   sheet?
): Promise<GenieRenderer | null>;

Defined in: website/components/media/expanded/genie-gpu.ts:158

Attempts the WebGPU/Rust genie backend on the overlay canvas. MANUAL drive — the genie driver's own eased clock owns frame(dt) pacing so both backends render identical progress sequences.

Parameters

canvas

HTMLCanvasElement

The overlay canvas (device-px sized by the driver).

el

MediaExpanded

The element — media source/dimensions.

from

GenieRect

Origin rect, viewport CSS px.

to

GenieRect

Destination rect, viewport CSS px.

opening

boolean

True on open, false on the collapse.

sheet?

GenieSheet | null

The composited modal sheet — uploaded as the warp texture when present (the media-file decode stands in otherwise).

Returns

Promise<GenieRenderer | null>

The renderer wrapping the widget handle, or null on any capability/artifact/init failure (the driver falls back to 2D).
